notes: Cross-cultural coverage is insufficient, so a second look using the sustainability report is triggered. The Item 7 excerpt only discusses open-source foundation models and has no qualifying activity. Excluded as traps: 'foundation' models and 'foundational' CUDA; 'training' meaning AI model training; chip 'design' and co-design; IP 'license and development agreements'; supply chain and sales in Asia and the Middle East; 'innovation' language. The Deep Learning Institute and the university partnerships appear under Sales and Marketing and AI evangelism, which is close to the 'educating customers as marketing' trap, so DLI was given no more than level 2 and the 'hundreds of universities' partnerships were not scored separately. The Graphics segment (GeForce and RTX workstation GPUs) is a reported segment, but no revenue is given in the provided text and it is mostly gaming, which is consumption rather than creation, so Creativity is not scored at 4. The 7.5 million CUDA developers relate to NVIDIA's own platform ecosystem and were not counted for Entrepreneurship.
